correctness.rationale: The standalone package explicitly constructs the integer weight-three reduced Świątkowski differential C3→C2 (1760 columns), its next differential C2→C1, and checks D2D3=0. Exact F2 elimination finds a 224-column 0/1 relation; its integer lift has D3c=2w with 360 coefficients ±1, D2w=0. Full F3 column rank proves D3 injective over Q and Z. Any integer z with D3z=w would force c=2z, impossible. Therefore [w] is nonzero of exact order 2 in H2; injectivity proves H3=0. The reduced-model comparison and quasi-isomorphism are cited from the inspected primary theorem, not inferred from finite enumeration alone. F5 and F101 full rank corroborate the crucial injectivity.

value.rationale: Tietze’s twelve-vertex cubic graph is a canonical nonplanar, non-Hamiltonian graph realized from Petersen by a vertex-to-triangle replacement. Higher integral homology torsion of unordered graph configuration spaces is a motivated nontrivial topological invariant, not implied by the classical planarity obstruction in first homology. A certified explicit order-two H2 class for three particles, not a Betti count, supplies a usable concrete test case for universal generators and higher-degree torsion theory. No full-group or minimum-size assertion is made.
